critical_code_review_comments: domain_routes.py: Lines 376-648 are a complete duplicate of lines 1-374. FastAPI uses first match so the new entity_type-aware code works. But the dead duplicate at line 479 (update_domain without cascade) is a silent time-bomb. Must be removed.
seed.py marketplace_products: Uses 'if count == 0' guard which prevents re-seeding when old data exists. Consider using 'ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE' or adding a hard reset for demo data.

update_domain cascade (PUT): Only cascades on active=False, not on active=True (no reverse cascade). This is documented as intentional but could confuse admins who re-enable a domain and don't see categories come back.
